title: Figma Project
description: Schema for a Figma project registration file.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier. Must match the filename (without .json).

description.description: A brief description of the Figma project.

figma_team_id.description: Numeric Figma team ID. Found in the URL: figma.com/files/team/<team_id>/...

figma_project_id.description: Numeric Figma project ID. Found in the URL: figma.com/files/team/.../project/<project_id>/...

url.description: Direct URL to the Figma project (for convenience).
